comment: Tier 1 references: a $row->{name} deref on a DBIC row is NOT a column reference (a column isn't a hash slot), so it never joins the column's cross-file reference set — references from the deref must not reach the column file.

rows.comment: H7-5: references on a 2-hop DBIC has_many accessor (synthesized only via cross-file ClassIsa) reach the call site in deep.pl.

Cursor on the QUALIFIER segment of `shift->SUPER::new` (the `SUPER::` half). method_name_span covers only the bare tail, so this cursor minted no identity: goto-def (span-generous) answered while references/rename/highlights came back empty. The identity gate now accepts the whole qualified token.
